children: Jazz Pharmaceuticals completed a private offering of $1.25 billion of 1.875% exchangeable senior notes due 2032, issued by subsidiary Jazz Investments I. The transaction, executed under an indenture on August 31, 2026, is expected to provide approximately $1,226.4 million in net proceeds for general corporate purposes. The notes carry an initial exchange rate of 2.8150 ordinary shares per $1,000 principal amount (exchange price of about $355.24) with settlement in cash, shares, or a mix at the issuer's election. The sale was supported by a Purchase Agreement signed with representatives of the initial purchasers on August 26, 2026.
